c.tagline: Silk Road oasis and China's best-preserved Islamic old city, gateway to the Pamirs.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis are metered; short trips are cheap, but agreeing a price or using Didi is common for longer or out-of-town rides. Carry your destination written in Chinese.

emergency.note: 110 reaches the police and 120 reaches medical/ambulance services; 119 is the fire brigade.

solo.f: generally fine; expect heavy security presence

avoid.reason: Xinjiang — heavy security, checkpoints and surveillance; restrictions on movement/photography; check advisories

hood_desc: The famous Kashgar Old Town (Ancient City), a labyrinth of mud-brick Uyghur houses, artisan workshops, teahouses, and lanes that has been a Silk Road crossroads for over two millennia; best for first-timers who want to stay amid the sights.
The city-center square in front of the yellow-tiled Id Kah Mosque, the spiritual heart of Kashgar, surrounded by shops, eateries, and mid-range hotels; a convenient, well-connected base.
The downtown stretch along Renmin Road, the modern commercial spine with department stores, banks, restaurants, and larger hotels; a practical, central place to stay.
The district around the Grand (Sunday) Bazaar and the Ostangboyi craft street, busiest on Sundays with carpets, spices, copperware, and livestock nearby; ideal for shoppers and market-goers.
The quieter East Lake (Donghu) Park area on the city's edge, with waterfront parkland and newer hotels away from the crowds; a calmer, greener base.

water.note: Drink bottled or boiled water only.

transit.hours: City buses generally run from around 7:00 AM to 9:00-10:00 PM; taxis and ride-hailing fill the late-evening gap.
transit.note: Kashgar has no metro or tram; getting around relies on an extensive city bus network plus cheap, plentiful taxis. The compact Old Town and central sights are easily walkable.
transit.pay: Buses take a rechargeable transit card, mobile QR payment (Alipay/WeChat), or cash; taxis are paid in cash or by app.

bus: Long-distance coaches across southern Xinjiang and to the Karakoram Highway

car.idp: Not valid; a temporary Chinese license is required to drive

train: Kashgar Railway Station (Southern Xinjiang Railway services to Ürümqi and intermediate cities)

transit.m: Airport bus / city bus to the center (~30-40 min)

tip.r: Tipping is not customary or expected in restaurants, taxis, or hotels.
